# Meetyou.me

> > Meetyou.me is a free online chat platform offering anonymous group chat rooms and video calling without registration across 200+ countries.

Meetyou.me provides instant access to country-specific chat rooms where users can connect with strangers locally or globally. The platform emphasizes privacy with no-registration access, supporting both text-based group chat and video calling features for social connections worldwide.
